$comment: FinancialInvariantSuite invariants that cannot yet be executed, because the
stock ledger (3, 10: Wave 5) they describe does not exist. 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8
left this list in M2-A; 9 (AR half) left it in M3-Q, 2026-10-01, when M3-P's
migrations and kernel flip made tests/accounting/ar-invariant-9.ts's checks
run against real rows instead of reporting unavailable. 9's AP half (vendors,
Wave 6) is still pending in substance, but this ratchet tracks ids, not
halves of an id — see invariants.ts's own note on id 9 for the split.
This list is a RATCHET. It may shrink and may never grow.
financial-invariant-suite.spec.ts fails if an invariant becomes pending that is
not listed here, and equally if one listed here has become enforced and the line
was not removed. Shrinking it is a deliberate act with a commit attached.
Never add an id to this file to make a failing suite green. A failing invariant
is a financial incident (NON_NEGOTIABLES §4), not a baseline to be widened.
